title: Meets
intro: Meets that are reviewed before they go live: an organiser's first two and every meet whose place is shown after an RSVP. The oldest is on top.
caption: Meets with waiting time, start, organiser, place and reports

empty.pending_body: New meets show up here as soon as an organiser sends them for review.
empty.published_body: Approved meets and meets of established organisers are listed here.
empty.rejected_body: Rejected meets stay here for twelve months with their reason.
empty.cancelled_body: Cancelled meets stay here for twelve months with their reason.
empty.all_body: As soon as members create meets and send them for review, they are listed here.

pane.label: Selected meet
pane.select_body: Pick a meet: it opens on the right with place, organiser and description. j and k switch, a approves, r rejects.
pane.gone: This meet no longer exists or is a draft again.

detail.place_private: Only the organiser and members who are going see the exact place. Your first look each day is in the audit log.
detail.place_public: The place is visible to everyone.

reject_dialog.title: Reject “:title”?
reject_dialog.body: The organiser reads the reason and can send the meet again with changes.

cancel_dialog.title: Cancel “:title”?
cancel_dialog.body: Everybody who answered is notified and reads the reason. The meet stays visible with the cancellation.

reopen_dialog.title: Send “:title” back to review?
reopen_dialog.body: The meet is no longer public until it is approved again. This works only while nobody has answered.

conflict.title: Changed meanwhile
conflict.changed: The meet was changed in the meantime. Reload it and review the current version.

view_only: View only: deciding needs a role with “Decide moderation”.
keys: Keyboard: j and k switch, a approves, r rejects, u undoes.

record.no_updates: The organiser has not posted any updates yet.
record.no_cases: There are no reports about this meet.
record.error: The meet could not be loaded.

flash.rejected: Meet rejected. The organiser gets the reason.
flash.cancelled: Meet cancelled. Everybody who answered is notified.
flash.not_possible: That is no longer possible: the meet was changed or decided in the meantime.
